headlines.headline: Karl-Anthony Towns says Knicks extension 'doesn't look good' before season opener
headlines.detail: Towns, eligible for a four-year, $276M deal, says a new contract isn't looking likely before the regular season as New York opened preseason against a Sixers team now fielding LeBron James and Jaylen Brown alongside Embiid and Maxey.

headlines.headline: Chiefs edge Raiders 30-27 to end Las Vegas's perfect start as Panthers upset Lions
headlines.detail: Kansas City improved to 4-0; Carolina stunned Detroit 32-26 on Sunday Night Football. Giants' Deonte Banks returned a pick-six 98 yards to beat Arizona, and Chicago's 492-157 yardage margin over the Jets was its best since 1979.

headlines.headline: Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith sets program records as Alabama, Missouri deliver Week 5's biggest road wins
headlines.detail: Smith caught 11 passes for 206 yards and 2 TDs in a 31-14 win over Iowa. No. 7 Alabama routed Mississippi State 56-23 and No. 25 Missouri upset No. 8 Florida 45-17.

headlines.headline: St. John's guard Donnie Freeman out for the season after Achilles surgery
headlines.detail: Coach Rick Pitino confirmed the non-contact injury will sideline the rising junior guard for all of 2026-27, a major blow to St. John's depth ahead of Big East play.
